doc.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023

title: Parents' reaction to her choice
summary: Her parents supported music but had trepidations once she wanted jazz saxophone as a living.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah. Were your parents curious about this bolt of lightening and were they supportive of your chosen path?

They were until I said this is what I want to do for a living. Then they did have their trepidations. They let me go ahead and they became more and more supportive. They were supportive of me playing music always because everybody in the family loved music. But jazz and saxophone — that was quite a stretch for them. But once they realized just how hard this struck me and how badly I really wanted and needed to do this and how much I applied myself then they really got it, they really got that, and then they just let me go ahead and do my thing.
